prompt: A high, locked, washed-out wide view from a lens above the till of a cheap cafe-restaurant, looking down on Brandon sitting alone at a table for two with a sauce bottle and a paper napkin in front of him, shoulders hunched, brows pinched, eyelids low, mouth tight, eyes aimed at the empty chair. Behind him, a woman in a long coat walks away through the glass door with her back to us, a bell above it swinging. Orange pendant lamps give a yellowish light, a laminated menu leans on the table, a fridge hums in the corner, and the colours are bleached with grain. Nothing is written on the picture. Thanks.
